name: Summer Schoolgirls
source: You play a girl just out of high school. In the summer before university, you have chosen to attend a special program where you can visit the campus and get to know your classmates. One of five characters will be chosen as your roommate and you must try to become friends with her, learn her secrets, and help her solve her problems. It will take clever detective work to form a lasting relationship.
